title: Arrival at the Stone Village
summary: Four Yaoguang elders corner Tu Fei and demand his head until his grandfather Tu Tian, seventh of the 13 Great Bandits, arrives with the real Heaven-Swallowing Demon Pot, captioned as an Extreme Dao Emperor weapon, and the elders retreat. Tu Tian scolds Tu Fei for lying, but Ye Fan has already slipped away with plenty of Yaoguang source. Ye Fan uses it to try for the Dao Palace but gets through only three of the nine transformations he needs, and concludes that the Ancient Holy Body needs 'endless' source. Nearby, a Master Chen ('Beard Chen') extorts five catties of source from Stone Village every three days, and villagers Lei Bo and Wang Shu stage a fake 'source-seeking technique' to fool him. After Ye Fan scatters Chen's men and the pair run off with his belongings, he catches them and bluffs them with a 'curse spell' until they admit that their Fifth Master is behind the trick. At Stone Village, Zhang Wuye explains that his family's ancient scroll of the Source Arts was lost long ago, and when Ye Fan insists, he leads him to Purple Mountain.
